title: Story world starts clean past the landing: no legacy heart, waves, portals, camp or yard; walls block and the gate animates
context: The owner: everything past the initial landing starts from scratch in the story world. The dot-cloud heart is retired for the story, the Terraformer 3000 gantry is the figurative Stalheart; no enemies yet; gates and walls must stop enemies and non-core enemies cannot damage them; the gate animates and lets the tank through; no camp containers or gantry-printed boxes.
outcome: A storyMode flag in td-tab.js (from world=story) gates: a new HEART_LOOKS.none entry (heart=none) that draws nothing; seedPortals, armWave conditions, the container cast, the station ring, tfStart and tfMilestone. Net controller size unchanged at 17,626 lines. base-plan gives every wall and the gate a nearest lattice cell; platform/story-world marks wall cells BLOCKED before the controller copies the tags, keeps the gate cell open, and story-base drives the gate's Gate_Open clip from the tank position with a 22 m open radius, closing behind it. Lab key G forces the gate for review. Tests: base-plan cells, world-recipe composition in Node (loads skipped without a document), browser: heart none, no berths, no queued enemies after 8 s, wall cells counted as rock, gate open and close in the lab. Enemy-side damage rules for walls belong to the encounter sub-project.
alternatives: Block the gate cell for everyone: rejected, the tank must drive through.
A separate story controller: still deferred; the flag is small and reversible.
evidence: node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world: PASS story-world, orbit, tank, stage1, gate
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story: PASS through stage 7 and the gate toggle
test/base-plan.mjs and test/world-recipe.mjs pass; npm test 88 programs
